Perfect! Now I have all the information I need. Let me compile the comprehensive report: ## SCSS and Frontend Pattern Exploration Report ### 1. SCSS About Page Classes (`resource/scss/pages/_sub.scss`) **Found `.no-sub-about-*` classes and layout structure:** | Class | Lines | Purpose | |-------|-------|---------| | `.no-sub-about` | 115 | Root about page container with nested BEM blocks | | `.no-sub-about-contents` | 71-86 | Canvas overlay container with z-index positioning | | `.no-sub-about-journey-surface` | 88-93 | Shared surface with backdrop blur (0.24 alpha) | | `.no-sub-about-section` | 116-126 | Section wrapper with flex layout | | `.no-sub-about-hero-intro` | 128-167 | Full viewport intro (100vh - header) with grid text layout | | `.no-sub-about-hero-slogan` | 169-316 | Sticky slogan section with keyword carousel, backdrop-filter blur(24px), alpha animations | | `.no-sub-about-who` | 318-491 | Showcase with orbital cards and ring effects | | `.no-sub-about-mission-vision` | 493-508 | Mission/vision grid with translucent surface | | `.no-sub-about-services` | 585-639 | Service list with grid layout (2fr 6fr 4fr) | | `.no-sub-about-proof` | 641-655 | **Canvas container** - 100svh height with full-size canvas | | `.no-sub-about-awards` | 657-669 | Awards section with title and contents | | `.no-sub-about-client` | 671-710 | Client logos in 4-column grid with backdrop blur | | `.no-sub-about-footer` | 712-731 | Footer with border top and meta/links | **Key CSS patterns:** - **Line 70-113**: `#main.no-sub-about` parent selector manages overlay opacity and sticky positioning - **Line 73**: `z-index: var(--z-index-canvas-overlay)` for canvas content layering - **Lines 89-93, 170-176, 590-592**: Three surface sections with `rgba(0,0,0,0.24)` + `backdrop-filter: blur(24px)` - **Lines 644-654**: `.no-sub-about-proof__canvas-wrap` uses 100svh height for full-screen canvas rendering --- ### 2. TypeScript File Structure #### **scene/** (Scene Configuration) - **File**: `resource/ts/pages/about/scene/about.scene.ts` - **Contains**: - Scene selectors mapping (lines 257-266): Maps 8 sections to DOM selectors with `data-scene` attributes - Scroll scene options (lines 274-340): Progress tracking config for each section - Background policy system (lines 342-382) - Scene runtime policies (lines 384-416): Overlay window definitions - Page config export (lines 491-522): Integrates all systems - **Sections defined**: heroIntro, heroSlogan, who, missionVision, services, awards, client, contact #### **runtime/** (Page Lifecycle) - **File**: `resource/ts/pages/about/runtime/AboutPageRuntime.ts` (45 lines) - **Class**: `AboutPageRuntime` implements `IPageRuntime` - **Key logic**: - Initializes `AppManager` for three.js main scene - Instantiates `AboutProofRenderer` for canvas gallery (lines 28-35) - Manages dual lifecycle: both three.js engine AND standalone canvas renderer #### **render/** (Standalone Canvas Gallery) - **File**: `resource/ts/pages/about/render/AboutProofRenderer.ts` (205 lines) - **Class**: `AboutProofRenderer` - **Three.js-based canvas gallery component** - **Architecture**: - Standalone `THREE.WebGLRenderer` (not main engine) - Queries `#about-proof-canvas` element - Loads work thumbnails via `fetchWorksList()` API - Renders cards as `THREE.PlaneGeometry` on a sphere (radius 9) with orbital rotation - **Proper disposal**: Calls `renderer.dispose()` + `renderer.forceContextLoss()` - **Resource cleanup**: Disposes all geometries, materials, textures (lines 105-112) - **Observer management** (lines 185-203): - ResizeObserver for canvas sizing - IntersectionObserver for visibility-based RAF control - **Key constants**: - SPHERE_RADIUS: 9 units - IMAGE_SIZE: 1.5 units per card - MAX_IMAGES: 24 thumbnails - ROTATION_SPEED_Y: 0.0005 rad/frame #### **theatre/** (Animation Control) - **AboutTheatreRuntime.ts** (80+ lines): Manages Theatre.js playback per section - **AboutTheatreConfig.ts** (74 lines): Defines 8 sheet IDs, storage keys, author/preview mode flags - **AboutSceneState.ts**: Camera, light, and object state definitions - **AboutSceneRig.ts**: Three.js object rig management - **AboutTheatreBridge.ts**: Scene-to-theatre binding - **AboutTheatreAutoplayRuntime.ts**: Intro/scroll autoplay logic --- ### 3. Types (`resource/ts/types/about.types.ts`) **Key interfaces defined (lines 1-308)**: | Type | Purpose | |------|---------| | `AboutSceneState` | Camera, light, background, objects state snapshot | | `AboutTheatreValue` | Theatre.js trackable values for 7 objects | | `AboutTheatreSheetId` | Union of 8 sheet IDs: heroIntro\|heroSlogan\|who\|missionVision\|services\|awards\|client\|contact | | `AboutSceneSectionKey` | Same 8 sections for scroll mapping | | `AboutWhoShowcaseConfig` | Card orbit/pose configuration with animations | | `AboutTheatrePlaybackStep` | Sheet playback range definition | | `AboutHeroSloganConfig` | Keyword carousel animation config | **About-specific state objects**: - `AboutTransformState`: position, rotation, scale, visible - `AboutCameraState`: position, target, FOV - `AboutBackgroundState`: exposure + look options --- ### 4. Three.js Gallery Components **Existing canvas-based gallery in `resource/ts/objects/`:** None of the objects implement gallery patterns directly. However: - **`AboutLights.ts`** (sub/): Lighting rig for about page - **`AboutTerrian.ts`** (sub/): Terrain mesh - **`Astronaut.ts`** (sub/): Character model - **Background.ts** (env/): Skybox/HDRI **Standalone renderer approach**: `AboutProofRenderer` is the ONLY canvas-based gallery component, rendering work proof cards. --- ### 5. Key Architectural Patterns **Canvas + DOM hybrid layout:** ```
``` **DOM Selectors mapping** (lines 257-266 of about.scene.ts): ```javascript heroIntro: '.no-sub-about-hero-intro[data-scene="heroIntro"]' heroSlogan: '.no-sub-about-hero-slogan[data-scene="heroSlogan"]' who: '.no-sub-about-who[data-scene="who"]' missionVision: '.no-sub-about-mission-vision[data-scene="missionVision"]' services: '.no-sub-about-services[data-scene="services"]' awards: '.no-sub-about-awards[data-scene="awards"]' client: '.no-sub-about-client[data-scene="client"]' contact: '.no-main-contact[data-scene="contact"]' ``` --- ## Summary **SCSS Classes Found**: 13 main `.no-sub-about-*` blocks + 30+ nested BEM modifiers **About page types**: Fully defined in `about.types.ts` (308 lines) **Canvas-based gallery**: `AboutProofRenderer.ts` - standalone Three.js renderer with orbital card layout **File structure**: Organized by responsibility (scene/, runtime/, render/, theatre/) **Disposal pattern**: Proper Three.js resource cleanup with `dispose()` + `forceContextLoss()`
